zh.title: 華航A330-300 B-18306傳退租　航跡紀錄列晚間自桃園離場
zh.summary: 據接獲消息，中華航空A330-300客機B-18306已退租。Flightradar24列出該機10月21日晚間自桃園離場的紀錄，但目的地未顯示，退租細節仍待官方確認。
body: 據接獲消息，中華航空Airbus A330-300客機B-18306已退租，並安排於晚間離開桃園國際機場。截稿時，尚未取得華航就該架飛機退租及後續移交安排的正式公告；退租消息與公開航跡所能確認的範圍，仍須分開看待。
航空追蹤平台Flightradar24的B-18306頁面，列出2026年10月21日航班CI77自臺北桃園機場（TPE）出發，實際離場時間欄位標示為UTC 14時19分，換算臺北時間為同日晚間22時19分。頁面未提供目的地，狀態欄亦未明確確認航班完成情形，因此目前不能據此判定最終去向、抵達時間或已完成退租交付。
公開資料將B-18306列為A330-302，屬於A330-300系列。退租是航空公司將租賃飛機交還出租方，並不等同飛機將永久停飛或拆解；該機未來是否轉租、轉售或另作安排，仍待後續消息。
華航近年持續推進機隊汰舊換新。公司2023年公布787訂單安排時，已說明新引進的787客機將替換A330-300；2026年第一次法說會簡報則規劃，A330-300機隊由2025年底的13架，降至2026年底的7架。這項數字是公司當時的年度規劃，並非B-18306退租的個別證明，也不代表目前機隊已完成縮減。

en.title: China Airlines A330-300 B-18306 Reportedly Returned off Lease; Tracker Lists Evening Taoyuan Departure
en.summary: Information received indicates that B-18306 has been returned off lease. Flightradar24 lists an October 21 departure from Taoyuan, but does not show its destination; lease-return details remain unconfirmed by the airline.
body: Information received indicates that China Airlines Airbus A330-300 B-18306 has been returned off lease and was arranged to leave Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport in the evening. At publication, no formal airline announcement confirming this aircraft's lease return or handover arrangements had been obtained. The reported lease status should be distinguished from what public flight-tracking data establishes.

Flightradar24's B-18306 page lists flight CI77 departing Taipei Taoyuan (TPE) on October 21, 2026, with 14:19 UTC in its actual-departure field, equivalent to 10:19 p.m. Taipei time that day. No destination is provided, and the status does not clearly establish that the flight has been completed. The entry therefore does not confirm its final destination, arrival time or completion of a lease-return handover.

Public tracking data identifies B-18306 as an A330-302, part of the A330-300 series. Returning a leased aircraft to its lessor does not necessarily mean permanent withdrawal from flying or dismantling. Whether this aircraft will be leased again, sold or assigned another role remains unknown.

China Airlines has been renewing its fleet. In a 2023 announcement on its 787 orders, it said the incoming aircraft would replace A330-300s. Its first investor presentation of 2026 projected reducing the A330-300 fleet from 13 at the end of 2025 to seven by the end of 2026. Those figures describe the plan at the time, not individual confirmation of B-18306's lease return or proof that the fleet reduction has already been completed.
